changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.43
- Custom overlay icons: replace the badge glyph for any module (3074 / 27k / 7500 / 30k / 30k Slow / Load / Reconnect / Game Pause). In Settings > Overlay Details, use the new "Custom icon" row - cycle to a module, click Choose, and pick any image (PNG/JPG/BMP/GIF). Reset reverts to the built-in icon. Power users can also drop files into the app's "icons" folder. Transparent PNGs look best.
